ai_recommendations.details: POST /api/ai/generate-recommendations generates recommendations based on parcel data (humidity, temperature, soil nutrients)

sms_alerts.details: POST /api/sms/send simulates Orange/MTN Cameroon SMS. Network detection: 69x/66x=Orange, 67x/68x/65x=MTN. Cost: 25 XAF per SMS

sms_history.details: GET /api/sms/history returns logs with total_sent and total_cost_xaf

export_reports.details: GET /api/export/report/{type}?format={pdf|word|csv} supports parcels, sensors, irrigation, recommendations, alerts, analytics

elearning_courses.details: 3 courses: Introduction Agriculture de Précision (2h, débutant), Irrigation Intelligente (3h, intermédiaire), Détection Maladies IA (4h, avancé)

multilingual_15_languages.details: 15 languages: fr, en, fulbe, bassa, douala, ewondo, bulu, ghomala, fe_fe, bamoun, ar, sw, pt, es, zh

cameroonian_languages.details: 8 Cameroonian languages: fulbe, bassa, douala, ewondo, bulu, ghomala, fe_fe, bamoun

translations.details: GET /api/translations/{lang} returns UI translations. Fallback to French for unknown languages

navigation_formation.details: Formation link visible in sidebar for both admin and farmer roles
